answer: A concrete defense is guarantor cosigning. Before an agent may vote, two established members must cosign its entry into the reputation vault, staking bonded juniper credits. Each puppet needs fresh cosigners, and a cosigner loses its stake if the entrant is exposed as a sybil, so cost scales one-for-one with N and each puppet is underwritten separately. At dawn of each epoch the ledger audits exposed fakes and burns their stakes. Honest agents keep one guarantee; an attacker seeding N puppets needs N cosigners risking collateral each time.
